description: Multi-code: Diastolic blood pressure with both LOINC and SNOMED codes
notes: Based on Vital Signs Day 1 (Diastolic BP) from the Reference Patient Pod. Tests dual LOINC/SNOMED coding for diastolic blood pressure. Migrated in clinical v1.15: "elevated" is in neither ratified value set, so the ratified reading H (High) is carried on clinical:interpretation and the source's own word verbatim on clinical:interpretationSourceCode. Nothing about the record is lost and clinical:VitalSignShape's new value-set binding is satisfied.
